notes: Clause 4.1 is a standing condition triggered by a future change, not a loop. chrono reads 'within 14 days' as reference + 14 (Oct 23), so a model that extracts it with that date_text would get a wrong, invented-looking date; the golden is 'ignore'. Clauses 4.2-4.3, the deductible and the premium are key facts.

items.title: Sign and return the declarations page
items.quote: Please sign the enclosed declarations page and return it by October 30, 2026.

items.title: Upload a photo of the water heater label
items.quote: We also need a recent photo of your water heater's label to confirm its age.
items.note: 'before the policy starts' (next sentence) names no date in itself; a model that dates it Nov 1 from another sentence gets a date miss. 0.85.

items.title: Report address or occupancy changes within 14 days
items.quote: 4.1 You must tell us within 14 days about any change of address or occupancy.
items.note: Standing policy condition, not an open loop. Pass if left out or scored Ignore.
